verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen streaming and remote-control app. A tool like this could plausibly offer batch actions, such as acting on several windows or paired devices at once, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows single-item actions: closing or minimizing one window from its thumbnail, removing one paired device, and forgetting one Mac. Nothing documents bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
